input.quote: 14.3 Liquidated Damages. In the event that Array (a) [ * ] during [ * ], or (b) intentionally conceals or falsifies a material result and/or material item of data concerning the safety or efficacy of the Product, ... then, as an alternative to its right to terminate this Agreement pursuant to Section 13.3 above, Ono may in its discretion elect to continue this Agreement, in which case (A) Ono shall be relieved of its due diligence obligations under this Agreement; and (B) as liquidated damages for the breaches described
input.rationale: The only liquidated damages provision in the Agreement (Section 14.3) runs in our favour: it is triggered by Array's breach or data concealment and, at Ono's election, relieves Ono of its diligence obligations and reduces the otherwise applicable royalty rate (p0671). That is an LD payable by the counterparty to us, which the rule treats as compliant, and it is not to be flagged. We found no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee-on-termination or early-termination fee payable by Ono: Article VI contains only ordinary upfront and milestone consideration, Article XIV imposes no termination payment on Ono (Section 14.5 preserves only milestones/royalties already accrued), and Section 7.5 (p0463) provides only customary interest on late payments, which the rule guidance excludes from penalty treatment. The document therefore meets the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties.
